summary: Dynex Capital Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to add Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley as sales agents under an existing at-the-market (ATM) distribution agreement for its common stock. The supplement updates the number of shares remaining available for issuance (approximately 50.4 million) and references a recent stock price of $13.79. This is a routine capital-raising filing, not a special situation event.
